strings.zh: 診斷標準(2018 EADV / TDA 2024 共識)
共病評估與篩檢(TDA 2024 強烈建議)
strings.en: Comorbidity workup and screening (TDA 2024 strongly recommended)

strings.zh: 重點:Dupilumab(度普利尤單抗 / 杜避炎)
第一線(Step 1):基礎照護 + 外用
第三線(Step 3):生物製劑與新藥
PN 為臨床診斷、須同時符合下列 3 項:
strings.en: PN is a clinical diagnosis requiring all 3 of the following:

strings.zh: PN 病人應系統性篩檢以找出可治療的根本誘因:
strings.en: PN patients should be systematically screened to identify treatable root causes:

strings.zh: 2022-2024 是 PN 治療的轉捩點 — 兩款生物製劑陸續上市:
strings.en: 2022–2024 marked a turning point for PN — two biologics have entered the market:

strings.zh: 盛行率全球 ~50/100,000(亞洲略低、但常被低估診斷)
strings.en: Global prevalence ~50/100,000 (slightly lower in Asia but commonly underdiagnosed)

strings.zh: 女性略多;發病高峰 50-60 歲(但年輕族群亦見)
strings.en: Slight female predominance; peak onset age 50–60 (but seen in younger patients too)

strings.zh: 共病:異膚 30-50%、慢性腎病、糖尿病、肝病、HIV、神經病變、惡性腫瘤、心理疾患
strings.en: Comorbidities: atopic dermatitis 30–50%, chronic kidney disease, diabetes, liver disease, HIV, neuropathy, malignancy, psychiatric conditions

strings.zh: 常因抓癢、摩擦造成色素沉著、結節中央潰瘍 / 結痂、苔癬化
strings.en: Scratching and friction often cause pigmentation, central nodule ulceration/crusting, and lichenification

strings.zh: 結節型疥瘡 — 採疥螨檢驗、家人接觸史
strings.en: Nodular scabies — scabies mite testing, household contact history

strings.zh: 結節型皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤(MF/SS) — 皮膚切片 + 免疫組織化學
strings.en: Nodular cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (MF/SS) — skin biopsy + IHC

strings.zh: 類天皰瘡前期(pemphigoid prurigoides) — 抗 BP180/BP230 抗體、DIF
strings.en: Prepemphigoid stage (pemphigoid prurigoides) — anti-BP180/BP230 antibodies, DIF

strings.zh: 反應性穿透性膠原病(尤其慢性腎病者)
strings.en: Reactive perforating collagenosis (especially in CKD patients)

strings.zh: HIV、淋巴瘤、副腫瘤性癢疹 — 視臨床線索做全身評估
strings.en: HIV, lymphoma, paraneoplastic itch — systemic workup based on clinical clues

strings.zh: 對稱分布、堅硬、邊緣清楚的結節
臺灣皮膚科醫學會 2024 PN 診斷與管理共識
strings.en: TDA 2024 PN Diagnosis and Management Consensus

strings.zh: 多發性、對稱分布、堅硬、邊緣清楚的結節
多發性、局部性結節型癢疹皮膚病灶
strings.en: Multiple or localized nodular pruritic skin lesions

strings.zh: 不需常規食物 / 環境過敏原檢驗
strings.en: Routine food / environmental allergy testing not needed

strings.zh: 剪短指甲、戴棉手套睡覺
strings.en: Trim nails, wear cotton gloves at night

strings.zh: 臺灣皮膚科醫學會。 結節性癢疹診斷與管理共識(TDA Consensus for Diagnosis and Management of Prurigo Nodularis)
strings.en: Taiwanese Dermatological Association. TDA Consensus for Diagnosis and Management of Prurigo Nodularis.

strings.zh: 頑固搔癢、Dupilumab 與 Nemolizumab 時代
strings.en: Refractory itch, the dupilumab and nemolizumab era

strings.zh: 過去 24 小時最強搔癢 0-10 分
strings.en: Worst itch in past 24 hours, 0–10 scale

strings.zh: ≥ 7 分:重度;反應 = 至少降 ≥ 4 分
結節數量與大小,0-4 分
0 = 無結節 / 1 = 接近清除(治療目標)

strings.en: 4-tier scale: mild, moderate, severe, very severe

strings.zh: 起始 100-300 mg 睡前;最高 3600 mg/day 分 3 次
strings.en: Start 100–300 mg at bedtime; max 3600 mg/day divided in 3 doses

strings.zh: 對神經性癢、年長病人有幫助;副作用嗜睡、頭暈
strings.en: Helpful for neuropathic itch and older patients; side effects include drowsiness, dizziness

strings.zh: 起始 75 mg bid;最高 600 mg/day
strings.en: Start 75 mg twice daily; max 600 mg/day

strings.zh: 合併情緒共病、夜間癢醒;Mirtazapine 鎮靜助眠
strings.en: For mood comorbidity or nocturnal awakening from itch; mirtazapine sedates and aids sleep

strings.zh: 膽汁鬱積性癢、頑固個案
strings.en: For cholestatic itch and refractory cases

strings.zh: off-label,無生物製劑可取得時的選擇
strings.en: Off-label option when biologics are unavailable

strings.zh: NB-UVB 對廣泛型 PN 有效;類固醇只能短期橋接
strings.en: NB-UVB is effective for generalized PN; corticosteroids only for short-term bridging

strings.zh: 適應症(FDA 2022, TFDA 已核准)
大多數應答者持續維持反應(NRS > 4 分降幅)
strings.en: Most responders maintain response (NRS reduction > 4 points)

strings.zh: 同時改善異膚、氣喘、CRSwNP、嗜酸性食道炎(若有)
strings.en: Concurrent improvement in atopic dermatitis, asthma, CRSwNP, and eosinophilic esophagitis (if present)

strings.zh: PN 適應症需自費(每針約 NT$ 16,000-20,000);AD 給付條件可申請
strings.en: PN indication is out-of-pocket (approx NT$ 16,000–20,000 per dose); AD reimbursement may apply if criteria met

strings.zh: 頭痛、異膚惡化(矛盾性)、特定病人結膜炎
strings.en: Headache, paradoxical AD worsening, conjunctivitis in some patients

strings.zh: TFDA 核可中、健保尚未給付、自費
strings.en: TFDA approval pending, NHI not yet covered, out-of-pocket
